## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** The backtest uses synthetic BS pricing and does not model slippage or liquidity; it assumes unit quantity (1 contract) per signal. For qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline.
2. **Sample bias:** Sample size is the 6 J anchor days (3 winners, 3 losers). Selection method is fixed by OP-16 source-of-truth. Overfit risk is low because we are not optimizing; we are measuring baseline.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (Stage-1 only; no OOS performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (BS-synthetic only).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day among J anchors is 4/29 with -$23.95 loss; max drawdown over the full backtest period is $4701.52 (per wide_pnl). Blow-up scenario: adverse regime where engine loses on winner days and gains on loser days.
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days of the wide backtest (225 trades) contribute 999.0% of P&L (indicating extreme concentration; see wide_pnl -$1464.23 and top5_pct 999.0).
